definitions.explanation: The way in which something is used or the purpose for which it is intended.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}な→様々：01559_samazama⟧{用途|ようと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{用途|ようと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じて→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please choose according to your intended use.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{用途|ようと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{限|かぎ}られている→限る：02033_kagiru⟧。
examples.english: The use of this land is limited to residential purposes.

notes:
USAGE: {用途|ようと} is commonly used in product descriptions, real estate, and legal contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {用途|ようと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ (has many uses)
- {用途|ようと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}った→合う：10466_au⟧ (suited to the purpose)
- {用途|ようと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じて→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧ (according to the use)
- {用途|ようと}⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧ (change of use)

LEGAL/REAL ESTATE:
- {用途|ようと}⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧ (zoning area)
- ⟦{住居|じゅうきょ}→住居：11612_juukyo⟧{用途|ようと} (residential use)
- ⟦{商業|しょうぎょう}→商業：09940_shougyou⟧{用途|ようと} (commercial use)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{使|つか}い{道|みち}→使い道：07798_tsukaimichi⟧ - use, purpose (more casual)
- ⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧ - purpose, objective
